notes.title: Optimization and Bugs Update + New Developer Title!
notes.notes:
Hiya! After the release of our other title:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037330/Senpai_Teaches_Me_Japanese_Part_1/] Senpai Teaches me Japanese: Part 1[/url]
we have come back to show our first game a little bit of love!

For the past few days we worked to update both of our titles, in Eurobi Racing specifically we:

• Made under the hood improvements and optimizations to the code
• Performed some small bug fixes

We hope this update fixes the leaderboards issue for good, as before they worked sometimes and not other times (a tricky issue to solve!!).

Cheers all, and look forward to future updates as we push those out as well!

notes.title: Bug fixes, Leaderboards and more!
notes.notes:
Leaderboards are here! Upon reaching new highschores, your score will be uploaded to a global leaderboard on Steam. You can officially compete with your friends scores, or go for the #1 spot! Which, currently, would be me :D I look forward to seeing what scores you all can come up with!

This update also fixes a few issues, including one with cops coming onto the screen while using the Ghost power-up. I also added the ability to use power-ups with the middle mouse button (also known as scroll click), and a button to mute the game within the options menu. Oh, and you can now skip those annoying load screens by simply clicking! Cheers, and happy playing ^_^

notes.title: 2 Weeks Update
notes.notes:
Hiya! Game dev here, back with another update. I hope everyone had a merry Christmas! Or, Holidays :D 

So, unfortunately I was not able to collect as much feedback as I had hoped. However, I do plan to push through some updates eventually, and a mobile port after said updates is very possible!

Because of the lack of feedback though, I will be putting my main focus into pushing out my other titles. This is mostly a good thing, as my other titles are much more serious projects. By this, I mean they are full sized games with a full story, soundtrack, and plenty to do from start to finish and afterwards.

If anyone has any questions, comments, or concerns, feel free to send me an email, or visit me at the subreddit. Thanks again, and cheers!
